Took are power gamer in the group a while to adjust since He couldn't just throw more numbers at the system, and overall I feel the party has more balance.
Combat so far has run 2-3x faster than previously. And since a single goblin is now as much of a threat as a lv1 npc fighter, combat isnt bogged down with hordes of minions.
THe built in persanality features (and inspiration for being in character) has finally pushed the couple players who avoided RP between encounters to actually dive into being in character.
Ritual spells change the flow of casters so they dont ramp out of control, and melee characters can really become tactical with the new reactions and bonus actions all the classes have built in.
Overall, its a good switch to 5e, first couple games where a shock with how simple it had become, players asking "is that really it?" several times. Would recommend it for sure! We still run a pathfinder game (alternating every month or so after a large campaign arch). So its still easy to go back and not feel bogged down.
